elevenlabsPrompt:
[playful] Still dragging windows around to get them side by side?

[confident] Here's the fix. Let Snap layouts do it.

[friendly] Hover over the maximize button. Click a zone in the grid. Pick the other window for the empty side. Or press Windows and the left arrow.

[delighted] Two windows, side by side, in two clicks.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
